trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned containing multiple duplicates (Sollathaan Ninaikkiren, Sundara Swapnagalu, Aakali Rajyam, Punnagai Mannan appear 3 times each; Varumayin Niram Sivappu, Arangetram, Idi Katha Kaadu appear 2 times each). All documents are relevant to the claim about Kamal Haasan starring in films directed by K. Balachander, who directed Sundara Swapnagalu.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop-1 retrieved documents establishing that K. Balachander directed Sundara Swapnagalu and that Kamal Haasan starred in multiple K. Balachander films. The summarizer correctly identified the claim as TRUE with complete evidence. Hop-2 and hop-3 queries both requested additional films starring Kamal Haasan directed by K. Balachander, retrieving largely overlapping document sets. The final output contains 24 documents with significant duplication, which is the specified behavior (no deduplication exists in the specification). All retrieved documents are relevant to the claim. The pipeline completed all three hops as required and returned the concatenated results.

events.evidence: Retrieved 7 documents including Sollathaan Ninaikkiren (directed by K. Balachander, starring Kamal Haasan, remade as Sundara Swapnagalu), Sundara Swapnagalu (directed by K. Balachander), and multiple other K. Balachander-Kamal Haasan collaborations.
